description: Non-regression contract: 359 previously-passing claims from the v0.8.6 repro package must produce identical verdicts under v0.8.8. No previously-supported claim may become contradicted or unknown; no previously-unknown claim may become supported. The 18 code-fixable claims (A1 6 + A2 11 + pizza-op-008 1) and 8 gold-label-disputed claims (B1/B2/C1) are excluded from this set (tracked separately).

expectedBehavior.verdictPreservation: Each previously-passing claim must produce the same verdict as under v0.8.7
expectedBehavior.noFalsePositive: No previously-supported claim may become contradicted or unknown
expectedBehavior.noFalseNegative: No previously-unknown claim may become supported

excludedClaims.codeFixable: A1 (6) + A2 (11) + pizza-op-008 (1) = 18 — tracked in a1/a2/pizza-op-008 contracts
excludedClaims.goldLabelDisputed: B1 (3) + B2 (3) + C1 (2) = 8 — tracked in deferred-claims contract

samplingStrategy.fullRun: All 359 claims run via acceptance-test.ps1 adapted for v0.8.8
samplingStrategy.representativeSample: At minimum, a 20+ claim representative sample must pass in V088NonRegressionIntegrationTest (Section 8.3)
